title: E-One Incorporated: ELECTRONIC STABILITY CONTROL SYSTEM MODULE (220 affected)
summary: E-ONE IS RECALLING CERTAIN MODEL YEAR 2008 THROUGH 2011 CYCLONE II, TYPHOON, AND QUEST VEHICLES MANUFACTURED FROM MAY 1, 2008, THROUGH NOVEMBER 28, 2011, AND EQUIPPED WITH MERITOR WABCO ELECTRONIC STABILITY CONTROL (ESC) MODULES. title: Children's Pajamas Recalled by Bella Bliss Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 2,300.

title: Club Car Recalls Golf Cars Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tank seam can separate and allow fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 600.

title: Nautilus Recalls Schwinn Elliptical Exercise Equipment Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The foot plates can detach from the machine during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 10,000 units.

title: West Elm Recalls Dover Dining Table Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The wooden base of the table can collapse, causing the glass table top to fall. This poses an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 830 in the United States and about 10 in Canada.

title: Madeline Bed Canopy Recalled by Pottery Barn Kids Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The connections of the posts to the top rails of the canopy can come apart, allowing components of the canopy to fall and posing an impact hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,700 in the United States and 230 in Canada.

title: Navien Recalls Tankless Water Heaters Due to Risk of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
summary: An unstable connection can cause the water heater's vent collar to separate or detach if pressure is applied. A detached vent collar poses a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning to the consumer. Units: About 13,000.

title: Build-A-Bear Recalls Colorful Hearts Teddy Bears Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The teddy bear's eyes could loosen and fall out, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: 284,000 in the United States and 13,200 in Canada.

title: Children’s Robes Recalled by Hanna Andersson Due to Violation of the Federal Flammability Standard
summary: These children's robes fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 1,000.

title: Holiday Tree, Wreath and Garland Set Recalled by General Foam Plastic Corp. Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery box that power lights on the artificial wreath can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Petit Lem Children’s Pajamas Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 1,750.

title: BRP Recalls ATVs Due to Loss of Control Hazard
summary: The Dynamic Power Steering (DPS) main shaft can crack and pieces can detach. Those pieces inside the DPS can block gears and cause limited steering ability, posing a loss of control hazard with risk of serious injury or death to the operator. Units: About 1,600.

title: Bugaboo Bee Strollers Recalled by Bugaboo Americas Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front swivel wheels can lock while the stroller is in motion, causing the stroller to tip and posing a fall hazard. Units: About 7,000 in the United States and 260 in Canada.

title: Bugaboo Car Seat Adapter Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: When the adapter is used on a stroller that also has a wheeled board accessory attached for transporting a standing toddler, and the car seat is positioned so the child faces forward, the car seat can disconnect from the adapter and fall. Units: About 64,000.

title: Target Recalls Circo Childrens' Travel Cases Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface coating on the travel cases contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 139,000 units.

title: BatteriesPlus Recalls Replacement Battery Packs Used with Cordless Tools Due to Explosion Hazard
summary: The replacement battery pack can explode unexpectedly, posing a risk of serious injury to consumers. Units: About 111,800.

title: Naturalizer Recalls Women's Dress Shoes Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The heels of the shoes can lean to either side, posing a fall hazard when worn by consumers. Units: About 6,100 pairs in the United States and 700 pairs in Canada.

title: The Pampered Chef Recalls Ice Cream Dippers Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: When the liquid-filled ice cream scoop is exposed to warm water, the cap and seal at the end of the scoop handle can fly off with substantial force, posing an impact injury hazard to nearby consumers. Units: About 20,000.

title: Historical eruption: VEI 2, Indonesia (2011-12-27)
summary: A significant volcanic eruption on 2011-12-27. 4 deaths. From NOAA NCEI's significant volcanic eruptions database (VEI: the volcanic explosivity index, 0 to 8).
